mapper.sql: subject_key, request_json, bucket, reserve, state, fence, plan_json
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM engine_delivery_schema_history WHERE version = #{version}
SELECT operation_id, fence, plan_json FROM LIMIT 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO (operation_id, subject_key, request_json, bucket, reserve) VALUES (#{id}, #{subject}, #{requestJson}, #{bucket}, #{reserve}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE SET fence = fence + 1, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE operation_id = #{id} AND subject_key = #{subject} AND state = 'PREPARING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= clock_timestamp()) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE SET plan_json = #{planJson}, updated_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds' WHERE operation_id = #{id} AND fence = #{fence} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp() AND plan_json IS NULL AND state = 'PREPARING'

UPDATE SET plan_json = #{planJson}, state = #{state}, updated_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_until = CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds' END WHERE operation_id = #{id} AND fence = #{fence} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp() AND plan_json = #{oldPlanJson} AND state = 'PREPARING'
UPDATE SET lease_until = NULL WHERE operation_id = #{id} AND fence = #{fence} AND state = 'PREPARING'
